raw_text:
Here’s the complete 12-week plan summary, integrating the moderate-intensity cardiac constraints, added strength emphasis, compound lift progressions, higher total cardio minutes for weight loss (still ≤70% age‑predicted max ≈115 bpm), and the cardiac‑friendly nutrition plan. Structure is week-by-week with sessions, sets/reps, and key cues.

Key guardrails for all 12 weeks
- Intensity: HR ≤115 bpm; RPE 3–5/10; talk test = full sentences.
- No Valsalva or maximal lifts. Exhale through effort; inhale on return.
- Warm-up 10–12 min (5–6 min easy cardio + mobility/activation). Cool-down 8–10 min (light cardio + stretches + diaphragmatic breathing).
- Stop if chest pain/pressure, unusual SOB, dizziness, palpitations.
- If on beta-blockers, rely more on RPE/talk test than HR.
- Progress only one variable per week (duration or load or reps).

Weekly split (Weeks 1–12)
- Day A: Cardio focus (steady moderate; progresses in minutes)
- Day B: Strength Upper
- Day C: Strength Lower + Core (with compound squat/hinge focus)
- Day D: Cardio focus (steady with “waves” that remain moderate)
- Day E: Strength Full Body (lighter; technique + accessories)
- Days F–G: Rest or low‑intensity walking/mobility (optional 15–30 min easy walks)

Cardio progression overview (all within HR ≤115)
- Long steady (LS): continuous moderate, RPE 3–4.
- Moderate waves (MW): 4–7 minute upper‑moderate blocks at RPE 5 separated by easy segments, but never let HR exceed 115.
- Mixed-modality easy (MM): shorter, easier cardio on strength days if desired (20–30 min).

- Weeks 1–4 weekly total: build from ~155 to ~235 min
- Weeks 5–8 weekly total: build from ~240 to ~290 min (Week 8 consolidate)
- Weeks 9–12 weekly total: build to ~315–340 min max, then maintain

Strength training overview
- Main lifts 3–4 sets of 6–10 reps, RPE 4–5; accessories 2–3x10–12; rest 75–120 s (extend to keep HR controlled).
- Compound progressions on Lower day: Goblet box squat → Smith/safety-bar box squat; DB/Kettlebell RDL → Trap-bar deadlift from blocks. Full Body day repeats patterns lighter for technique.
- Upper day prioritizes machine press/pull patterns for safety and stability.

Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Base, technique, and consistency
Goal: Establish routine, dial in breathing, add initial strength volume; cardio builds to ~220–235 min/week.

Week 1
- Cardio
  - Day A LS: 25–30 min RPE 3–4
  - Day D MW: 30–35 min with 3 x 4 min upper‑moderate blocks (3 min easy between), HR ≤115
- Strength
  - Day B Upper
    - Machine chest press 3x8
    - Seated cable row 3x8–10
    - Lat pulldown 3x8–10
    - Seated DB shoulder press 2–3x8
    - Triceps pressdown 2x10–12
    - DB curl 2x10–12
  - Day C Lower + Core (compounds start)
    - Goblet box squat 3x6–8 (box at knee height)
    - DB RDL (after hinge drill) 3x6–8
    - Supported split squat 3x6–8/leg
    - Calf raises 2x12–15
    - Pallof press 2x10/side
    - Dead bug 2x8/side
  - Day E Full Body (lighter)
    - Goblet box squat 2–3x8–10
    - Chest‑supported DB row 2–3x8–10
    - Cable chest fly 2x10–12
    - Back extension to neutral or hinge drill 2x10
    - Farmer carry light 2x30 m
- Optional MM: 20–25 min easy cardio after strength sessions (if energy good)

Week 2
- Cardio: Day A LS 28–32 min; Day D MW 35–38 min with 4 x 4 min blocks
- Strength: Add one set to one primary per day (e.g., chest press 4x8; goblet squat 4x6–8). Add face pull 2x12–15 to Upper.

Week 3
- Cardio: LS 30–35 min; MW 38–40 min with 4–5 x 4 min blocks
- Strength:
  - Upper: keep primaries toward 4x8–9; add rear delt or external rotation 2x12
  - Lower: DB/Kettlebell RDL 4x6–8; Goblet box squat 4x6–8
  - Full Body: maintain 2–3x8–10 on patterns

Week 4
- Cardio: LS 45–48 min; MW 40–42 min with 5 x 4 min blocks; weekly total ~220–235 min
- Strength: Hold loads, perfect tempo/breathing. If all sets ≤RPE 4, note for next week’s 2–5% load bump.

Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength emphasis within moderate effort; cardio volume up
Goal: Keep primaries in 6–8 range, introduce safer compound variants; weekly cardio 240–290 min (Week 8 consolidate).

Week 5
- Cardio: LS 48–50 min; MW 42–45 min with 5 x 5 min blocks
- Strength
  - Day B Upper
    - Machine chest press 4x6–8
    - Seated cable row 4x6–8
    - Lat pulldown 3x8
    - Seated DB shoulder press 3x6–8
    - Triceps pressdown 2–3x10–12
    - Incline DB curl 2–3x10–12
  - Day C Lower + Core
    - Goblet box squat → transition to Smith or safety‑bar box squat 3–4x6–8
    - DB/Kettlebell RDL 3–4x6–8
    - Supported split squat 3–4x6–8/leg
    - Seated calf 3x12
    - Pallof 2–3x10/side; Side plank (elevated) 2x20–30 s/side
  - Day E Full Body (lighter)
    - Goblet box squat 3x8–10
    - Chest‑supported row 3x8–10
    - Reverse lunge to box 2x8/leg
    - Cable woodchop 2x10/side
    - Farmer carry 3x30–40 m easy

Week 6
- Cardio: LS 50–52 min; MW 45–47 min with 6 x 4–5 min blocks
- Strength: If prior RPEs ≤4, add 1 rep per set (up to 8) or smallest load. Add hip abduction machine 2x12 and rear delt machine 2x12 at the end of Upper/Full Body.

Week 7
- Cardio: LS 52–55 min; MW 47–50 min with 6 x 5 min blocks
- Strength:
  - Lower: Introduce Trap‑bar deadlift from 6–8 in blocks 3x5–6 at RPE ≤5 with full reset; keep Smith/safety‑bar box squat 3–4x6–8
  - Upper/Full Body: maintain volumes; add very light sled push 2x20 m on Full Body if HR stays ≤115

Week 8 (consolidate)
- Cardio: Maintain Week 7 minutes or trim any one session by ~10% if fatigue accumulates.
- Strength: Keep primaries steady; drop one accessory set each session to freshen up. Technique focus and HR control.

Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Consolidate strength, event-specific walking, and peak moderate cardio volume
Goal: Maintain 3 strength days with compounds; cardio up to ~315–340 min; prepare for submax 30‑minute walking test in Week 12.

Week 9
- Cardio: LS 55–58 min (flat to 1–3% inclines as tolerated); MW 50–52 min with 6–7 x 4–5 min blocks
- Strength
  - Day B Upper
    - Machine chest press 4x6–8
    - One‑arm supported cable row 3x8/side
    - Lat pulldown 3x8
    - DB shoulder press 3x6–8
    - Cable external rotation 2x12/side
    - Triceps pressdown 2x10–12
  - Day C Lower + Core
    - Safety‑bar/Smith box squat 3–4x6–8 OR goblet/front squat 3x6–8 if stable
    - Trap‑bar deadlift from blocks 3x5–6 (keep block height; no grinding)
    - Step‑ups 2–3x8/leg
    - Calf raises 3x12–15
    - Pallof + Dead bug 2 rounds
  - Day E Full Body (lighter)
    - Landmine press half‑kneeling 3x8/side (light)
    - Chest‑supported row 3x8–10
    - Split squat 2–3x8/leg
    - Cable woodchop 2x10/side
    - Farmer carry 3x40 m easy

Week 10
- Cardio: LS 58–60 min; MW 52–55 min with 7 x 5 min blocks
- Strength: If last week ≤RPE 4–4.5, increase primaries 2–5% or +1 rep (cap 8). Add hamstring curl 2–3x10–12 on Lower and cable lateral raise 2x12 on Upper.

Week 11
- Cardio: Maintain Week 10 or add 3–5 min to one LS and one MW (total up to ~340 min).
- Strength: Keep primaries 4x6–8; add controlled 3s eccentric on one primary per session without load increase. Optional add 1 accessory set if HR/RPE stable.

Week 12 (taper for test; technique week)
- Cardio: Maintain total minutes but keep the longest LS at 45–50 min easy‑moderate to stay fresh. Include one event‑specific steady walk (45–50 min) on the intended surface.
- Strength: Reduce primaries to 3x6–8 and accessories to 2x10–12, RPE ~4; technique and breathing focus.

End-of-program submax walking fitness test (safe alternative to a 5K time trial)
- Use a 30‑minute moderate walk test on flat ground or treadmill.
- Warm-up 10–12 min easy. Walk 30 minutes at the fastest sustainable pace that keeps HR ≤115 and RPE ≤5. Avoid surges. Cool down 8–10 min.
- Record distance, average/peak HR, RPE, and recovery feeling at 10 minutes. Compare to prior efforts.

Daily/weekly mobility and breathing (2–4x/week, 8–12 min)
- Thoracic rotations, cat‑camel, hip flexor stretch, hamstring strap stretch, calf stretch, pec doorway stretch.
- Diaphragmatic breathing: 4–6 slow breaths x 2–3 sets post‑workout.

Nutrition plan (cardiac‑focused, weight‑loss supportive)
- Overall pattern: Mediterranean/DASH hybrid.
- Calories: Modest 300–400 kcal/day deficit for weight loss; adjust to lose ~0.3–0.7% body weight per week.
- Protein: 1.1–1.2 g/kg/day (80–95 g if ~80 kg), 20–30 g per meal.
- Carbs: High‑fiber, low‑GI sources; time a portion around workouts.
- Fats: Emphasize unsaturated; saturated fat <7–10% of kcals; avoid trans fats.
- Fiber: 35–40 g/day; sodium 1,500–2,000 mg/day (or per clinician).
- Hydration: 2–3 L/day unless restricted; add 250–500 mL on cardio days.
- Plates: Half veg/fruit, quarter lean protein, quarter whole grains/legumes; olive oil or nuts for fats.
- Weekly anchors: Fish 2–3x, legumes 3–5x, nuts/seeds daily, low‑fat dairy 1–2 servings if tolerated.
- Pre‑workout (60–90 min): light carb + protein (banana + yogurt; oatmeal + berries).
- Post‑workout (within 2–3 h): balanced meal with 20–30 g protein.
- Restaurant/travel: grilled/baked, sauces on side, no added salt, prioritize veg; limit alcohol.
- Special considerations: Coordinate with clinician if on warfarin (steady vitamin K), diabetes meds (monitor glucose), statins (report unusual muscle soreness).

Progress tracking and adjustments
- Weekly: body weight (same conditions), training log (HR, RPE, minutes, symptoms).
- Biweekly: waist circumference; adjust calories ±100–150 kcal or cardio minutes ±30–40 based on trend and recovery.
- Strength: Progress only when last sets are ≤RPE 4–5 and HR ≤115; otherwise hold or deload one set.
- Safety: If any cardiac symptoms appear, stop session and seek medical guidance; re‑introduce with reduced volume/intensity once cleared.

This summary provides the full, integrated 12‑week roadmap: high‑volume moderate cardio for fat loss, progressive but safe strength with compound patterns, cardiac‑appropriate testing, and nutrition aligned to heart health and weight loss.
